name: Penelope Sinclair
source:
Penny is smart as a whip, ruthless, and painfully loyal. She's fiercely independent, but she's fed up of being surrounded by arrogant men who think they know better. She's ballsy and brash, but underneath that seemingly cold exterior is someone warm who cares deeply about those close to her. She'll do anything to get to the bottom of the mysteries that consume the city, including putting herself in potentially dangerous situations.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lunarisgames/call-me-under-a-queer-1950s-visual-novel/description]Kickstarter[/url]]

Penny can be romanced on her own or as part of a polyamorous triad with Callie.
